text: If you're thinking to start posting brand on Instagram, I need you to hear this before you post any sort of thing. You have to be intentional and I'm not talking about being consistent, I'm talking about being intentional about posting any sort of content you post. There's a huge difference between consistent and being intentional. Consistent is posting every single day because some guru told you to post that on Instagram. Intentional is knowing about what are you posting and whom you're targeting on Instagram. And it's nothing to do with your consistent posting. I see people posting 300 days and still ending up nowhere. No real audience, no clients and nothing. And that part still hurts because that was like, I'm being consistent but why I'm not actually getting where I want to be. Because the direction was never the part of the plan. They knew what to post and they never asked who is it for or what it's supposed to make that person actually feel while posting any sort of content. Your brand is actually the body of decisions and not the body of content. Decide who you want in your DMs and who you want to be known for in your niche or an industry. Otherwise, of course, you're not building a personal brand, you are just being busy with your work.
